ownerNeed: Analyze extended .NET 11/C#15 numerics, migration and refactor opportunities within M8-W02

candidates.feature: BigInteger internal 64-bit limb rework and conversion correctness
candidates.finding: Observed use of BigInteger.GreatestCommonDivisor, Pow, DivRem and rational comparisons; assess net11 runtime wins without changing canonical values.
candidates.action: Benchmark same source on .NET 10 vs 11, compare exact results, huge operands, cancellation/budget and Windows/Linux architecture.

candidates.finding: Candidate explicitly approximate decimal representation, NOT replacement for ExactRational or System.Decimal.
candidates.action: Assess new typed scalar/value provenance and decimal binary conversion boundaries with exact reference oracles, rounding, NaN, signed zero and infinities.
candidates.migration: separate opt-in contract and versioned serialization

candidates.finding: Potential reusable framework generic complex arithmetic; exact existing numerics source type and candidate signatures need inventory.
candidates.action: Inventory actual complex use, T constraints, branch cut, precision and interoperability; compare existing provider and .NET 11 behavior.
candidates.migration: adapter only if qualified; do not promise all T

candidates.feature: Correctly rounded conversions / partial parsing / floating-point hex
candidates.finding: Potential parser/codecs simplification, but custom grammar is an intentional mathematical contract.
candidates.action: Falsify round-trip, locale, partial consumption, overflow, hexadecimal and exact-vs-binary semantics with pinned corpus.
candidates.migration: keep accepted grammar and explicit policy

candidates.feature: SIMD cross-lane Zip/Unzip/Concat, FP16 and JIT vector optimizations
candidates.finding: Candidate implementation changes for finite matrix/vector kernels, only if actual hot paths and CPU support justify.
candidates.action: Benchmarks throughput/allocation on x64/Arm64 with scalar oracle and numerical error bounds, hardware feature fallback.
candidates.migration: targeted kernels, no blanket intrinsic rewrite

candidates.finding: Candidate sampling utilities; deterministic seeded behavior and distribution guarantees may differ.
candidates.action: Assess exact RNG APIs, distributions, reproducibility and boundaries; keep reproducibility promises explicit.

candidates.feature: Union types and closed hierarchies in C# 15
candidates.finding: Observed bounded polymorphic IR JSON. New language constructs may model exact/approximate/status cases but must not silently change format or discriminants.
candidates.action: Test compiler exhaustiveness, source-generated JSON, AOT trimming, patterns, semantic hashes and previous IR wire fixtures.

candidates.feature: Decimal, BigInteger and typed numeric JSON support
candidates.finding: New serializer converters may reduce custom code but canonical transport needs stronger invariants.
candidates.action: Verify byte-identical canonical schema, invalid payload refusal, NaN representation, culture and AOT constraints.

candidates.finding: Representative scientific functions should be benchmarked and evaluated for numerical stability rather than migrated mechanically.
candidates.action: Differential net10/net11 tests, independently computed reference values, domain/precision budgets and source-free NuGet consumer.

gates: Inventory all 13 package source APIs and tests before authoring replacements
Classify semantic compatibility and versioned public/wire contracts
Build with verified GA SDK on isolated net11 configuration; preserve exact net10 source baseline
Run independent exact/decimal/complex/SIMD/JSON correctness oracles and targeted performance measurements
No silent exact-to-decimal float conversion; report rounding, domains, NaN and invalid values
Qualify on supported OS/RID and emit observed matrix, not inferred support
No mutation of immutable packages or public publication absent owner decision
crossWorkstream: M8-W01 Discovery metadata must reflect admitted numeric types and precision policies, but M8-W01 remains scheduled before M8-W02 implementation.
limitations: Candidate impact assessment, not a verified net11 migration
Some platform documentation pages have RC/preview wording; GA release announcement dated 2026-11-10 is the current release authority
Only ExactRational.cs and IrCanonicalJsonCodec.cs were directly inspected for this research seed; other module file paths are inventory targets, not source-verified findings
